group: MurmurHash3.hash32(long, long, int) - branch and value coverage

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (e.g., 0x5A5A5A5A). The result must be the same on every execution and must not throw an exception.
cases.description: Baseline test using the default seed and zero data. Verifies that the method returns a consistent hash value when all inputs are zero.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (different from the hash obtained with the default seed). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Checks that changing the seed influences the final hash even when the data payload is all zeros.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (non‑zero, distinct from previous cases). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Stress test with the maximum positive long values and the maximum positive int seed to ensure the algorithm correctly handles large positive numbers.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (non‑zero, distinct from all other cases). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Uses all‑bits‑set values (‑1) for both longs and a negative seed to verify that sign‑extension and two's‑complement handling are correct.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (non‑zero, distinct from previous cases). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Mixed pattern data with a non‑default seed to exercise all four calls to mix32 (low/high parts of both longs) and to trigger any internal conditional logic inside mix32/fmix32.

group: MurmurHash3.hash32(long, long, int) - additional edge and order sensitivity

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (different from all previously listed hashes). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Tests handling of the most negative long value combined with a zero long while using the default seed. This exercises the sign‑bit propagation through Long.reverseBytes and the mix steps.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (different from the previous case, confirming that the order of the two long arguments matters). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Same values as the previous case but swapped; verifies that hash32 is not commutative with respect to data1 and data2.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (non‑zero, distinct from all other cases). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Combines the extreme negative and positive long values together with the most negative int seed, stressing the algorithm's ability to mix opposite‑sign inputs.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (non‑zero, distinct from all other cases). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Uses a pattern where only the low 32 bits of the first long and the high 32 bits of the second long are set. This forces mix32 to process distinct low/high halves and checks that no accidental masking occurs.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (different from the case that uses seed 12345, confirming seed sensitivity). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: Repeats the mixed‑pattern data from an existing test but changes the seed to zero, ensuring that the seed influences the final hash even when the data payload is identical.

cases.expected: deterministic int hash (non‑zero, distinct from all other cases). No exception is thrown.
cases.description: All‑bits‑set long for data1 combined with a zero long for data2 and a zero seed. This checks correct handling of unsigned overflow and the effect of a zero seed on a maximal data value.
